source_title: Whirlpool WRS325SDHZ Owner's Center (Water Filter EDR1RXD1)
filter_location_text: Whirlpool WRS325SDHZ side-by-side models use an everydrop Filter 1 cartridge in the upper-right fresh-food compartment.
replacement_steps_summary: Whirlpool support guidance for EDR1RXD1: remove the old filter cartridge, install the new everydrop Filter 1 until locked, flush water, then reset the filter indicator when prompted.
cautions: Whirlpool recommends genuine everydrop filters; non-genuine filters may not be covered under warranty.
notes: Tier 1 Whirlpool bundle for WRS325SDHZ — Owner's Center and product page list EDR1RXD1 (everydrop Filter 1) as the model water filter.
